verdict.rationale: Rive's docs describe components as reusable artboards whose customized instances stay linked to the source, with source changes reflected across all instances. That covers reuse and linkage. The docs only say instances are "customized" and never mention variants or what can be overridden per instance. missing for 10: documented variant support, explicit description of per-instance override mechanics and which properties can be overridden, independent or hands-on corroboration.
